questions.question: Selection of Pisum sativum for hybridization experiments, because of -
options: Presence of 7 characters and short life span.
Presence of contrasting characters and short life span.
Presence of long life span and fertile hybrid.
Presence of many observable hybrids and easily availability of plant.
questions.explanation: mendel selected pisum sativum due to the presence of contrasting characters which made it easier to study inheritance patterns along with its short life span which allowed multiple generations to be studied quickly

questions.explanation: Complete linkage means that genes are very close to each other and crossing over is entirely absent. Test cross means that the F1 generation is crossed with the recessive parent. Since the crossing over is absent in complete linkage then there will be 100% parental character in the test cross i.e. there will be no recombinants.

questions.question: Which of the given genotype represent homozygous condition?
questions.explanation: A test cross is an experimental hybrid between an organism having a homozygous recessive genotype and an organism with a dominant phenotypic but unknown genotype. There are some recombinant individuals if P and Q, the paternal genes that exhibit linkage, are crossed with their respective p and q forms. Genes in incomplete linkage have a tendency to separate due to recombination because of their distant locations on the same chromosome, which increases the likelihood of them crossing over. We are finding some recombinant individuals in this query, which suggests that the paternal genes are only loosely related. recombinants means parental population , which is greater than 50% but less than 100%

questions.question: First time mathematical and statistical analysis used in biology by...
questions.explanation: During Mendel’s investigations into inheritance patterns it was for the first time that statistical analysis and mathematical logic were applied to problems in biology.

questions.explanation: T.H Morgan was an evolutionary biologist, geneticist, embryologist, and renowned science author. He was awarded the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine in 1933 for discoveries in the role of chromosomes in heredity. The term linkage was given by TH Morgan, who carried out several dihybrid crosses in the fruit fly, Drosophila. With this set of experiments, he could study genes that were sex-linked.

questions.question: Which of the following trait of pea plant was not studied by Mendel in his experiment?
questions.explanation: Mendel did not study Pod Length in his experiments on Pisum sativum. He focused on seven traits, including Flower Position, Seed Colour, and Seed Shape, but Pod Length was not among them.
